items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Claudia Castor had given me a great write-up in the Chicago Tribune on the front page.

ctx.x: Prior to the Orchestra Hall concert? Was it just on the basis of that one review?
Yes. Claudia Castor had given me a great write-up in the Chicago Tribune on the front page.
How much of it was also working with Joe Sherman and therefore, Joe Glaser’s office?
